name: CrossModality.com
overview: Cross-modality describes how intelligent systems relate, translate, and integrate information across vision, language, audio, and real-world sensory inputs. Across AI, robotics, and advanced sensing, it underpins the shift from single-task models to architectures capable of reasoning across these modalities.
The term offers a defining identity for companies developing foundation models, embodied AI, medical imaging technologies, and multimodal perception.
